implementation.friend_request_rules: The target account stores everyone, friends-of-friends and shared-server rules as validated preferences. The friendship service evaluates them before creating a new request, so direct API calls cannot bypass the controls.
implementation.mutual_source: Mutual eligibility is derived from accepted friendship records for the target and a second accepted-pair lookup for the sender.
implementation.server_source: Shared-server eligibility intersects server membership IDs read from the server repository; it does not trust client claims.
implementation.compatibility: Accounts without the new preference retain the previous everyone-enabled behavior until they save a stricter rule.
implementation.message_requests: A first message from a permitted nonfriend moves the channel atomically to pending, records the initiator and notification, limits the initiator to one message, and only lets the recipient accept or decline.

automated_verification.result: pass; covers direct-policy rejection, mutual auto-accept, pending state, friends-only enforcement and request settlement

remaining_acceptance: Use two signed-in browser clients to exercise each rule across reload, then accept and decline a message request while observing both clients.
